decision: Selected the planar centroid of the municipal reservation-agreement polygon recorded for Eco Data Center AB on property Västansjö 2:7 in Smedjebacken's map service (EPSG:3009), transformed to WGS84, as the campus locator for EcoDataCenter's third campus. It marks the land reserved for the data-centre establishment in Röbackens industriområde; it is not a building, the 2026 option boundary, the detailed-plan area or the industrial area's centroid.

selected_properties.personal_data_note: The layer's contact-person field was not requested.

computation.server_outsr4326_check: The same feature requested with outSR=4326 (local_data/country-research-nordics-p1/smb-reservationsavtal-eco.geojson, sha256 1e2b2cf4c4e6ef1264ca7b6ebd5669ef4e3f45c16c3b6ceb245b53b9dc8217cf) has a planar centroid of [15.3999721, 60.1245304], agreeing within 1e-7 degrees.

identity_bridge: Smedjebacken kommunfullmäktige 21 September 2026 § 44 (Dnr 2024/00349): approves EcoDC's option to acquire industrial land in Röbackens industriområde (about 51.6 ha, part of the property Smedjebacken Västansjö 2:7) for the establishment of a data centre, through the municipal company Röbacken 1 AB.
Smedjebacken news of 25 August 2026: dialogue since 2019 between the municipality and EcoDataCenter about acquiring parts of Röbackens industriområde for data centres; option agreement for 52 ha.

Municipal GIS: the only reservation-agreement feature for the company (query on company names containing ECO or DATA) is OBJECTID 1608, 'Eco Data Center AB', property 'Västansjö 2:7', 23.6 ha, which lies entirely within detailed plan D 203 Röbacken (75.5 ha) and 83% within area 1 of Västansjö 2:7 (214.1 ha).

consistency_checks.plan_d203: Detailed plan D 203 Röbacken (plan information layer, local_data/country-research-nordics-p1/smb-dpinfo-roback.json, sha256 535773c8a163ca07dda05b3b6ccbb8bcde1baba6d3856f5662676c375d12e555): 755,143 m2; the reservation polygon lies 100% inside it; plan-area centroid [15.3965191, 60.1259813] is 251 m from the selected point and is not used.
consistency_checks.property_vastansjo_2_7: Fastighetsytor layer (local_data/country-research-nordics-p1/smb-fastighetsytor-vastansjo-2-7.json, sha256 8785aa7d8d5e560a1546055d5d04a2d4e5d5c7fa45b02f92931cbca6010aa583): Västansjö 2:7 has five areas; area 1 is 214.1 ha and holds 83.3% of the reservation polygon; the property's centroid is not used.
consistency_checks.area_discrepancy: The 2021 reservation covers 23.6 ha, while the 2026 option covers about 51.6 ha of Västansjö 2:7 (exact area to be fixed by cadastral procedure) plus a 6.5 ha lease; the option boundary is not published, so the reservation is used as the best project-specific municipal geometry.

transform_check: Planar centroid computed in EPSG:3009 with shapely 2.1.1 and transformed with pyproj 3.7.1 (PROJ 9.5.1, always_xy) to EPSG:4326; SWEREF 99 is treated as coincident with WGS84 at this precision.
